name: Smoke
comment: 24.6.2 — minimal smoke group. NOP (0x90) + HLT (0xF4) only. Both single-byte, no operands, no flags touched. Proves the SpecLoader → DecoderTable wiring accepts x86 encodings before the real groups land in 24.6.5+.

formats.name: Nop
formats.comment: 0x90 NOP — actually XCHG AX,AX in silicon, but the framework treats the no-op identity case as its own decoded entry.

formats.name: Hlt
formats.comment: 0xF4 HLT — halt until next external interrupt. Emitter raises a halt signal; the runtime breaks out of the per-block loop. writes_pc=always so block-JIT BlockDetector ends the block at HLT (otherwise the block would walk past into garbage memory and clobber FLAGS during pre-halt execution).
